messages:
maya (Support): Hey team — customer Hana from AcmeRetail reports the Console dashboard for their store metrics is returning blank panels and occasional 500s when loading charts. They pasted the error: "500 Internal Server Error: analytics-query-timeout" and request id `req_0x9af3e7`. They can repro in Chrome (incognito) and via our UI.
Hana (AcmeRetail): repro steps I did: 1) login -> open /console/dashboards/store-overview -> filters: last 24h, store_id=acme-ny -> graphs show spinner then blank. Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/abc123. I tried refresh and waited ~30s, got 500.
support-bot: Alert linked: #alert/analytics-api-high-5xx triggered (count=58 in last 5m).
oliver (eng-analytics): thanks, Maya — can you paste the request id and a timeline? Also which dashboard panels are affected (timeseries vs histogram)?
maya (Support): request id above. Affects timeseries panels and a custom metric panel that uses `agg:sum` of `checkout.latency_ms`. Customer saw `504` and `500` intermittently.
jeff (sre): I'm seeing a cluster-wide spike in query latency on analytics-query-frontend around 2026-03-16T18:42Z. Logs show repeated `context deadline exceeded` and `panic: engine overloaded` from aggregator nodes. Rolling window of high CPU on agg-02.
oliver (eng-analytics): FWIW we rolled out config change to `max_query_time` from 45s -> 15s earlier today to reduce long-running scans. That could cause upstream 500s if backend queues spike. Can we check queue depth and any recent retention/ingest jobs?
jeff (sre): queue depth up to 120 concurrent queries (target 50). There's also a retention job kicking off at 18:40 that increased scan pressure. I'm pausing that retention job now.
maya (Support): Noted — telling customer we're investigating and pausing. Hana, will update within 10m. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Deploy rollback of config `analytics-frontend: max_query_time=15s` -> `45s` initiated by jeff at 2026-03-16T18:48Z.
oliver (eng-analytics): Rolling config back on frontend + bumped aggregator replicas for the hot partition. Monitor for 5m. Also enabling a read-fallback to replica cluster `analytics-ro-2` for dashboards to reduce pressure.
jeff (sre): CPU on agg-02 dropping and query latency trending down. 5xx rate from 38/min -> 3/min after rollback.
maya (Support): Hana — can you try refresh now?
Hana (AcmeRetail): refreshed at 18:55 — graphs loading! Some panels still slow but no 500s. Thank you.
maya (Support): Closing the loop: cause was aggressive `max_query_time` roll and coincident retention job creating scan pressure. Fix: rollback + temporary replica fallback. Eng-analytics to follow up with a mitigation plan (rate limiting long scans, schedule retention off-peak).
oliver (eng-analytics): Will create a follow-up RFC/incident ticket with perf baseline and a safer rollout plan for `max_query_time`. Suggestion: gradual ramp + synthetic load test.
jeff (sre): posting runbook updates to /runbooks/analytics-query-overload and adding an alert for queue-depth > 80.
maya (Support): Thanks everyone. Hana, ping us if anything recurs — we'll keep monitoring for next 24h. :heart:
Hana (AcmeRetail): confirmed stable for now, appreciate the quick help!
